primary_decision: Existing preregistered worst-fold/cost score and central-cell destructive-control rules are unchanged.

secondary_diagnostics.allocator_identifiability: Compare the full target path of each central candidate with its ablation and falsifier. Different signals with identical targets are no deployable alpha contribution.
secondary_diagnostics.paired_return_uncertainty: Candidate minus its matched ablation/falsifier at 4% ATR slippage, dev fold only, preserving contiguous daily dependence with circular moving blocks.
secondary_diagnostics.interval: 95% percentile interval for annualized arithmetic mean return difference; not CAGR and not a selection-adjusted significance test.
secondary_diagnostics.historical_incumbents: Unavailable matched V10/V11/V12 streams remain PENDING; no metric borrowing.

interpretation: Secondary diagnostics can undermine a mechanism claim; they cannot promote a strategy or rescue a failed preregistered gate. Reused development history and multiple testing limit inference.
execution_delay: Additional delay stress is required only for surviving candidates before forward testing. No delay parameter optimization.
